 Follow Kim Kardashian Looks Impossibly Cinched in a Custom Dress From Ashi Studio
 Joel Calfee Tue, November 3, 2026 at 11:26 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Kim Kardashian Stuns in a Silvery, Skin-Tight Gown Theo Wargo - Getty Images "Hearst Magazines and Yahoo may earn commission or revenue on some items through these links." 
 K im Kardashian has been holding nothing back on the All's Fair season two press tour . With the help of her stylist, Law Roach, the Skims founder has stepped out in everything from a daring cut-out Galia Lahav gown to a vintage beaded Todd Oldham design . At one point, she even had the opportunity to do a photoshoot in Elizabeth Taylor's emerald-and-diamond Bulgari necklace , which was gifted to the Old Hollywood star on her 30th birthday by Richard Burton. So, it makes sense that for the NYC premiere of her Hulu legal drama, Kardashian brought out yet another showstopping ensemble.
 On Monday night, the reality star and business mogul arrived to the red carpet in a silvery, impossibly-cinched gown, custom-made by Ashi Studio .
 Kim Kardashian walks the red carpet at the New York City premiere of All's Fair season two.Theo Wargo - Getty Images
 According to the brand's official Instagram , the design took over 500 hours to create, and it was constructed through meticulous craftsmanship from artisans at the Ashi Studio ateliers in Paris.
 Advertisement Advertisement The sculptural design was composed of alternating panels of gray Chantilly lace, suede, and crocodile leather. Kardashian's waist was cinched with a corset bodice, while the sides of the dress were trimmed with long suede cords that hung down like fringe and also formed the off-the-shoulder sleeves. Meanwhile, folds of fabric hung from the skirt to create a slight train, and the look was completed with a matching thick leather choker up top.
 Kardashian wore a custom, multi-fabric look from Ashi Studio.Theo Wargo - Getty Images
 On-screen, the characters in All's Fair wear powerful, dramatic, and elegant ensembles that suit their formidable nature. Clearly, Kardashian wanted to bring that same energy to the carpet, too.
